instructions.title: VPN connection instructions
instructions.chooseApp: Choose which app you want to install?

setupSteps: Download and install OpenVPN Connect for your operating system.
Go to Config files in the dashboard and download the .ovpn profile for the location you want to use.
Open OpenVPN Connect and choose Import Profile or tap the + button.
Select File, upload the downloaded .ovpn profile, and confirm the import.
Allow the VPN profile if your device asks for permission.
Tap Connect. When the status changes to connected, your traffic is routed through Prometey VPN.
Download and install the recommended VLESS client for your operating system.
Go to Config files in the dashboard and copy your VLESS link, or open the QR code when it is available.
Open the client and choose Add profile, Import from clipboard, or Scan QR code.
Import the Prometey VPN configuration and save it in the app.
Select the new Prometey VPN profile in the server list.
Tap Connect. If the first connection fails, recheck that the copied link is complete and try again.
